tips.title: Avoid visual effects on highlighted overlapping entities
tips.body: This process requires considerable processing power.

tips.title: Smooth transition view time
tips.body: Enter the smooth transition time in seconds.

tips.title: Auto-widen thin lines for printing
tips.body: This is often necessary when working with imported data.

tips.title: Improve text quality with TrueType fonts
tips.body: For title blocks and drawing frames.

tips.title: Activate model silhouette calculation for print commands
tips.body: Calculating silhouettes can take some time.

tips.title: Set anti-aliasing for smooth curves and edges
tips.body: Reduces aliasing effects.

tips.title: Set background colors for graphics area as a gradient
tips.body: Select Top and Bottom colors.

tips.title: Highlight face boundaries in different colors
tips.body: Use 'Boundary color' to specify the color.

tips.title: Set color for system graphic curves
tips.body: Specify the color for selection area drawn with the mouse.

tips.title: Set color for referenced entities of a hyperMILL® job
tips.body: Specify the color.

tips.title: Show mesh entities with edges of tessellation triangles
tips.body: For 'Shaded and edges view' or 'Shaded with hidden lines'.

tips.title: Select line type for displaying face boundaries
tips.body: Choose from available options.

tips.title: Enable global color library transparency
tips.body: Specify the intensity as a percentage.

tips.title: Choose display of hidden lines or edges
tips.body: In the graphics area.

tips.title: One-off rendering of entities when a document is loaded
tips.body: Displayed entities are subsequently read from cache memory.

tips.title: Activate display of model silhouette as a graphic in the current view
tips.body: With 'Edge view' and 'Edge view with hidden lines'.

tips.title: Highlight open edges of solids in color
tips.body: Select the color for the open edges.

tips.title: Select color of triangulation triangle boundaries for 'Tessellation view'
tips.body: Specify the color.

tips.title: Select transparency type for calculation
tips.body: Performance-based choice recommended.

tips.title: Modify tessellation precision of TrueType font text elements
tips.body: Adjust the precision.

tips.title: Select number of zebra lines for zebra analysis
tips.body: Specify the number.

tips.title: Disable OpenGL Offscreen Rendering function
tips.body: If software crashes due to memory content switching.

tips.title: Show graphics performance at bottom left of graphics area
tips.body: Use 'Show frame rate'.

tips.title: Switch from isometric to perspective display in the graphics area
tips.body: Use 'Perspective projection'.

tips.title: Select render mode for graphics area
tips.body: Choose from available options.

tips.title: Entities in the graphics area create a shadow
tips.body: Use 'Self shadows'.

tips.title: Set number of cached views
tips.body: Default value is 10.

tips.title: Set default setting for Project snap points
tips.body: Choose from available options.

tips.title: Define the highlight for displaying meshes
tips.body: Choose from 'Default', 'Bounding box', or 'No highlight'.

tips.title: Enable automatic preselection after exiting a command
tips.body: Results of the command are selected for next action.

tips.title: Keep preselected entities if command is cancelled
tips.body: Automatice preselection must be enabled.

tips.title: Switch off dynamic entity selection for toolpaths
tips.body: Select 'No dynamic highlight' or 'Bounding box'.

tips.title: Make entities selectable through transparent colored entities
tips.body: Use 'Pick through transparent color'.

tips.title: Enable precision check during Shape → Fillet command execution
tips.body: If deviation arises, a message is output on the Info tab.

tips.title: Specify threshold for precision check
tips.body: Enter a value for the deviation.

tips.title: Repair solid before modifying it using automatic methods
tips.body: Try to close a solid before modifying it.

tips.title: Assign solid layer to solid faces when adding a feature
tips.body: If a face inside a feature or the feature itself is changed, the solid layer will be used again.

tips.title: Collect resulting coplanar faces into an entity
tips.body: Face simplification option.

tips.title: Allow open solids as results
tips.body: Use 'Allow non manifold results'.

tips.title: Limit the extension of faces to find a new trim edge
tips.body: Increase or decrease the factor as needed.

tips.title: Disable repeated attempts for generating a result
tips.body: Use 'Iterate' option.

tips.title: Switch the direct modeling of solids on or off
tips.body: Use 'Enable direct editing'.

tips.title: Case sensitive filtering
tips.body: Take upper and lower case into account when filtering.

tips.title: Filter by start of string
tips.body: The character string should be at the beginning of the individual part name.

tips.title: Select all filtered parts
tips.body: All filtered individual parts are selected for import.

tips.title: Deselect all filtered parts
tips.body: Removes all filtered, selected individual parts from the selection.

tips.title: Save settings for different CAD formats
tips.body: Settings are stored in an *.xml file for each interface format.

tips.title: Filter metadata names for each CAD format
tips.body: A separate filter can be applied to metadata names for each CAD interface format.

tips.title: Use ISLIKE operator for wildcard matching
tips.body: Search for matches using wildcard characters, where * matches any character or string and ? matches any single character.

tips.title: Rename metadata names for each format
tips.body: Metadata names can be renamed to tag names for each format.

tips.title: Assign values for each metadata name
tips.body: Different metadata values can be assigned for each format.

tips.title: Import PMI with MBD
tips.body: Dimensions, surface finishes, and tolerances are imported automatically evaluated by the software.

tips.title: Convert hidden entities during import
tips.body: Enable the Convert hidden entities option under Entity conversion modes.

tips.title: Set view to workplane
tips.body: Set the view to the current workplane (XY plane).

tips.title: Set view to selected face
tips.body: Set the view to the selected face.

tips.title: Move, zoom and rotate the model view
tips.body: Move, zoom and rotate the model view using the left mouse button.

tips.title: Press ESC key to exit command
tips.body: Press the ESC key to exit the command.

tips.title: Select all entities
tips.body: Use 'Select → All' or 'Ctrl+A'

tips.title: Select a contour or boundary
tips.body: Use 'Select → Chain'

tips.title: Select entities within a polygonal line area
tips.body: Use 'Select → Lasso'

tips.title: Select entities within a rectangular area
tips.body: Use 'Select → Window'

tips.title: Select entities within a circular area
tips.body: Use 'Select → Circular'

tips.title: Select entities arranged in an arc
tips.body: Use 'Select → Circular sector'

tips.title: Select entities within a closed chain of curves
tips.body: Use 'Select → From curves loop'

tips.title: Select visible entities within a polygonal line area
tips.body: Use 'Select → Lasso visible entities'

tips.title: Select visible entities within a rectangular area
tips.body: Use 'Select → Window visible entities'

tips.title: Select visible entities within a circular area
tips.body: Use 'Select → Circular visible entities'

tips.title: Select visible entities arranged in an arc
tips.body: Use 'Select → Circular sector visible entities'

tips.title: Select center of arc
tips.body: Click the center of the arc with the left mouse button.

tips.title: Select vertices of curve loop
tips.body: Click two diagonally opposite corners with the left mouse button.

tips.title: Select visible entities from curves loop
tips.body: Select visible entities within a closed chain of curves.

tips.title: Select entities for hyperMILL® job
tips.body: Select entities (curves, contours, boundaries, faces, solids, points) for a calculation in a hyperMILL® job.

tips.title: Select parent entity
tips.body: By selecting an entity inside, the parent entity (solid, group, V-sketch, feature) is selected.

tips.title: Select child entity only
tips.body: By selecting an entity inside a closed parent entity, the entity is automatically opened for selection inside and only the chosen entity itself is selected.

tips.title: Select limited faces
tips.body: In a solid or in a face model, select all faces within adjacent faces.

tips.title: Select fillet faces
tips.body: Select faces in the course of a constant fillet within a solid or a face model.

tips.title: Select chamfer faces
tips.body: Select faces in the course of a constant chamfer within a solid or a face model.

tips.title: Select tangent faces
tips.body: Select faces that are ‘linked’ with a tangential transition within a solid or a face model.

tips.title: Select coplanar faces
tips.body: Select coplanar faces.

tips.title: Select coaxial faces
tips.body: Select coaxial faces within a solid.

tips.title: Invert selection of entities
tips.body: Invert the selection of entities. All unselected entities are selected and the entities that are selected are no longer selected.

tips.title: Set selection filter for points
tips.body: Set a filter for the selection of entities using commands like Set points filter.

tips.title: Set selection filter for curves
tips.body: Set a filter for the selection of entities using commands like Set curves filter.

tips.title: Set selection filter for faces
tips.body: Set a filter for the selection of entities using commands like Set faces filter.

tips.title: Reset selection filter
tips.body: Reset the selection filter to the previous setting.

tips.title: Snap entities
tips.body: Snapping is used for precise 'latching' to the geometrically significant position of an entity.

tips.title: Snap point types in Select → Snap
tips.body: Table of snap point types including Workplane origin, End point, Middle point, Center point, Origin point, Face vertex point, Point on curve, Point on face, Curve intersection point, Mesh vertex point, Toolpath polyline-point, Stock model point.

tips.title: Set minimum and maximum values for curvature analysis
tips.body: Select a minimum Min. value and a maximum Max. value. Values below Min. are shown in dark grey, values above Max. are displayed in light grey.

tips.title: Configure analysis boundaries for concave or convex areas
tips.body: For convex areas, use [- value, 0]. For concave areas, use [0, value].

tips.title: Exclude planar entities from curvature analysis
tips.body: Planes and very flat entities are automatically excluded from the analysis and displayed in dark pink.

tips.title: Use tessellation for accurate analysis
tips.body: The lower the values of Tessellation and Edge length, the more accurate the result, but the longer the calculation takes.

tips.title: Analyze distances between two faces or meshes
tips.body: Select Shape A and Shape B entities to analyze distances between them.

tips.title: Set transparency for entities in shape analysis
tips.body: Transparency can be set for the entities selected in Shape A or Shape B based on the direction defined by Normal to A and/or Normal to B.

tips.title: Generate curves from levels in color map analysis
tips.body: Enter the number of levels and generate curve entities from the levels displayed.

tips.title: Check document warnings for potential issues
tips.body: Analyze the warnings detected when opening or inserting to ensure the document is error-free.

tips.title: Isolate mating entities based on constraints
tips.body: Display entities and their matings determined by constraints between them and highlight in the model tree.

tips.title: Project point or direction onto XY plane
tips.body: If selected point or direction is not on default XY plane, it will be projected onto the XY plane for alignment.

tips.title: Invert Z axis direction
tips.body: Invert the positive Z axis direction to face the opposite direction, while X and Y directions remain unchanged.

tips.title: Offset workplane in Z direction
tips.body: Move the workplane in the Z axis direction by entering a value.

tips.title: Create workplane on axial face/hole
tips.body: Create a workplane with origin and orientation such that the center line determines the direction of the Z axis, and the center position gives the origin.

tips.title: Align X axis to entity
tips.body: Align the X axis to an entity by selecting it, or project a point parallel to a direction (line).

tips.title: Save workplane in document
tips.body: Click the line with the left mouse button and enter a name to save the workplane in the document.

tips.title: Modify workplane using Move command
tips.body: Double-click the axes of a current workplane with the left mouse button to call the Move command.

tips.title: Reset to world workplane
tips.body: Click the line with the left mouse button and select 'On world' to reset to the world workplane.

tips.title: Align workplane to current view
tips.body: Click the line with the left mouse button and select 'On view' to align the workplane to the current view.

tips.title: Rotate workplane around X axis
tips.body: Click the line with the left mouse button and select 'Rotate' -> 'Around X' to rotate the workplane around the X axis.

tips.title: Set current workplane
tips.body: Select the workplane and click 'Set current' to set it as the current workplane.

tips.title: Hide/unhide workplane
tips.body: Click the line with the left mouse button and select 'Hide / unhide' to activate/deactivate the display of the current workplane.

tips.title: Delete workplane
tips.body: Click the line with the left mouse button and select 'Delete' to delete the selected workplane.

tips.title: Select entities for operations
tips.body: Select one or more entities to perform operations like creating points, intersections, or projections.

tips.title: Set parameters for points on curve
tips.body: Parameters include Start, End, and No. of points to align points following the curve's parameters.

tips.title: Calculate inflection points of a curve
tips.body: Select the direction for calculating inflection points, which are displayed in the graphics area.

tips.title: Project points onto entities or workplane
tips.body: Select points to project and target entities or a workplane for the projection direction.

tips.title: Define a plane for projection
tips.body: Use 'Entity', '3 points', or 'Direction + origin' to define a temporary plane for projection.

tips.title: Create lines with constraints
tips.body: Select 'None', 'Tangent', or 'Normal' to constrain line creation based on entity properties.

tips.title: Create parallel lines from a base line
tips.body: Select the base line and specify options like 'Fixed', 'Length', or 'Distance' for creating parallel lines.

tips.title: Create rectangles with different modes
tips.body: Select 'As rectangle' or 'As lines' to create a closed contour or individual curves for a rectangle.

tips.title: Create center lines on circles and arcs
tips.body: Select entities to create center lines aligned parallel to the axes of the current workplane or via entity geometry.

tips.title: Create circles or circular arcs with different modes
tips.body: Select 'C. + R.', 'C. + P.', '3 P.', or 'R. + 2 P.' to create a circle or circular arc based on selected points.

tips.title: Select unwrapping mode
tips.body: Choose between Linear or Radial mode based on entity type.

tips.title: Specify unwrapping direction
tips.body: Use an entity, two points, workplane axis, or vector to define the direction.

tips.title: Select target face for unwrapping
tips.body: Choose a cylinder, rotational, or linear sweep face as the target.

tips.title: Fit unwrapping to target face
tips.body: Scale the unwrapped shape to fit the selected target face.

tips.title: Create plane face
tips.body: Select a planar entity, three non-collinear points, or specify direction to create a plane face.

tips.title: Select boundaries for plane face creation
tips.body: Choose entities to define the boundaries of the plane face.

tips.title: Invert orientation of plane face
tips.body: Optionally invert the normal direction of the created plane face.

tips.title: Create bounded plane face
tips.body: Generate a plane from coplanar curves, planar boundaries, or almost planar boundaries.

tips.title: Create linear sweep face
tips.body: Generate a single curved face by sweeping outer contours and island contours.

tips.title: Select curves for linear sweep
tips.body: Choose boundaries to define the shape of the swept face.

tips.title: Set draft angle for linear sweep
tips.body: Specify an angle between 0° and 89° to control the slope of the swept face.

tips.title: Create multishell solid
tips.body: Select all unconnected curves in a V-sketch to create a multishell solid.

tips.title: Select curves for multishell solid creation
tips.body: Choose the curves and boundaries to define the shape of the solid.

tips.title: Set draft angle for multishell solid
tips.body: Specify a draft angle to control the slope of the solid.

tips.title: Trim extruded faces to existing faces
tips.body: Select entities to trim the extruded faces to fit existing shapes.

tips.title: Select entities for face trimming
tips.body: Choose the entities that will trim the extruded faces.

tips.title: Set direction for face trimming
tips.body: Specify the direction of the extrusion using an entity, two points, workplane axis, or vector.

tips.title: Create rotational face
tips.body: Generate one or more faces by rotating selected entities between specified angles.

tips.title: Select entities for rotational face creation
tips.body: Choose the entities to define the shape of the rotated faces.

tips.title: Set rotation angle for rotational face
tips.body: Specify the start and end angles of the rotation.

tips.title: Create solid from faces and solids
tips.body: Combine multiple faces and solids into a single solid.

tips.title: Select constraints for automatic application
tips.body: Choose from Coincident, Parallel, Tangential, Horizontal, Vertical, Perpendicular, Dimensional constraints.

tips.title: Apply constraints manually in V-sketch
tips.body: Select entities and assign constraints like Point-Line, Coincident (X/Y), Radius, Length.

tips.title: Manage external references in constraints
tips.body: Create relations to entities outside the edited V-sketch for parallel, coincident, etc.

tips.title: Dimension V-sketch entities
tips.body: Use Distance, Angle, Radius, Length modes to create dimensional constraints.

tips.title: Change dimensional constraint values
tips.body: Select a measure and modify its value to adjust the V-sketch geometry.

tips.title: Hide V-sketch constraints for better visibility
tips.body: Select the V-sketch to hide or show its constraint highlights.

tips.title: Convert entities to parametric for dynamic modeling
tips.body: Right-click on entities and select 'Convert to parametric' for dynamic geometry changes.

tips.title: Deactivate features in parametric models
tips.body: Right-click on a feature and select 'Deactivate' to temporarily remove it from the model.

tips.title: Rebuild parametric models after changes
tips.body: Edit > Parametric > Rebuild parametric model to update the geometry based on new parameters.

tips.title: Activate parametric modeling in hyperMILL®
tips.body: File > Options > Solid editing options > Enable parametric modeling to use parametric features.

tips.title: Limitations of direct modeling in parametric CAD
tips.body: Direct modeling cannot restore lost faces and edges, requires a section curve for 'Re-trim', and cannot be used on parametric models.

tips.title: Use direct modeling for features and faces in solids that were modelled directly in the software
tips.body: Direct modeling can also work for a feature within a feature, such as a fillet in a slot. Existing fillet features and chamfer features within a feature are not modified as well.

tips.title: Convert static entities to parametric by creating a contour line around the entity and converting it to a V-sketch
tips.body: This method allows for dynamic changes in the model without losing the original geometry.

tips.title: Roll back to a previous state in the model tree using the Roll back command
tips.body: This allows for manual control over the modeling process and can be used to export specific states of the model.

tips.title: Assign Boolean tags to features for controlled activation and deactivation
tips.body: This allows for dynamic control over feature states based on parameter table values.

tips.title: Modify features using direct modeling or the 'Change parameters' command
tips.body: Direct modeling allows for interactive changes to feature shapes, while 'Change parameters' provides more detailed control.

tips.title: Select curves and boundaries for linear protrusion
tips.body: Select entities to define the contour for generating a linear protrusion.

tips.title: Specify height for linear protrusion
tips.body: Enter a Height value or use the handle to specify the height of the protrusion.

tips.title: Mirror mode for linear protrusion
tips.body: Enable mirror mode to generate a mirror-image protrusion in both directions.

tips.title: Select direction for linear protrusion
tips.body: Choose the direction by selecting an entity, specifying two points, or using workplane axes.

tips.title: Create a linear slot
tips.body: Select curves and boundaries to define the contour for generating a linear slot.

tips.title: Specify height for linear slot
tips.body: Enter a Height value or use the handle to specify the height of the slot.

tips.title: Mirror mode for linear slot
tips.body: Enable mirror mode to generate a mirror-image slot in both directions.

tips.title: Select direction for linear slot
tips.body: Choose the direction by selecting an entity, specifying two points, or using workplane axes.

tips.title: Create a rotational protrusion
tips.body: Select curves and boundaries to define the contour for generating a rotational protrusion.

tips.title: Specify start and end angles for rotational protrusion
tips.body: Enter the start and end angles of the rotation or drag the handles to define the angle range.

tips.title: Create a rotational slot
tips.body: Select curves and boundaries to define the contour for generating a rotational slot.

tips.title: Specify start and end angles for rotational slot
tips.body: Enter the start and end angles of the rotation or drag the handles to define the angle range.

tips.title: Create a symmetric angle
tips.body: Select contours and apply an angle evenly in both directions.

tips.title: Select direction for symmetric angle
tips.body: Choose the direction by selecting an entity, specifying two points, or using workplane axes.

tips.title: Create a hole with further machining
tips.body: Select the type of hole (thread, fit, slot, countersink) and configure additional machining options.

tips.title: Configure hole parameters
tips.body: Enter specifications for the selected composition of the CAD feature, including length, diameters, and angles.

tips.title: Select thread type or tolerance class
tips.body: Choose a thread type or tolerance class for the fit feature.

tips.title: Select thread or fit designation
tips.body: Choose a specific thread or fit designation from the catalogue selection.

tips.title: Enter thread or fit depth
tips.body: Specify the length of the thread or fit, including minimum length requirements for core holes.

tips.title: Select thread direction
tips.body: Choose left-hand or right-hand thread direction for the typically used right-hand threads.

tips.title: Select fit/through depth
tips.body: Choose full depth or advanced settings for the length of the thread or fit through the feature depth.

tips.title: Specify hole position
tips.body: Select an entity, enter a distance, or use point definitions like In Point definition, Snap center position, Project, Starting from 2 edges, Free point.

tips.title: Set alignment for CAD features
tips.body: Select Normal to face or specify a direction using an entity, two points, workplane axis, vector, or invert the direction.

tips.title: Use library for CAD features
tips.body: Select a template from the Library (base) or Library (advanced), including User library, Company library, and Application library.

tips.title: Create patterns with CAD features
tips.body: Multiply existing entities in one direction (Linear) or by rotating at an angle (Angular), specifying count, direction, and origin.

tips.title: Create protrusions between contours
tips.body: Select two contours and a face to embed the protrusion, optionally synchronize points for better alignment.

tips.title: Create slots between contours
tips.body: Select two contours and a face to embed the slot, optionally synchronize points for better alignment.

tips.title: Generate or modify fillets
tips.body: Select edges of a solid and enter a radius to create or modify a fillet with a constant radius.

tips.title: Convert faces into analytical faces before repairing open solids
tips.body: This improves calculation results.

tips.title: Set minimum tangent extension for erosion faces
tips.body: Select a value greater than 0 to avoid curve intersections.

tips.title: Set minimum linear extension for erosion faces or tangential extension
tips.body: Select a value greater than 0 to avoid collision avoidance.

tips.title: Add stabilization extension to electrode
tips.body: Enter a length greater than 0 for stabilization.

tips.title: Set minimum block height for electrode
tips.body: Enter a value greater than 0 to adjust the block size.

tips.title: Define minimum block offset for electrode geometry transition
tips.body: Enter a value greater than 0 to maintain necessary offset.

tips.title: Optimize C angle for electrode holder
tips.body: Automatically rotate the electrode holder to save material.

tips.title: Manually set C angle for electrode holder
tips.body: Turn the electrode holder without activating the Optimized C angle option.

tips.title: Create side electrode for unreachable erosion areas
tips.body: Use the Side electrode option to create a side electrode in XZ, YZ or XYZ direction.

tips.title: Control joint size for side electrode
tips.body: Define Joint angle, Min. lateral joint length and Min. vertical joint length.

tips.title: Specify length for lateral path of side electrode
tips.body: Enter a minimum necessary length based on the Info tab.

tips.title: Enable automatic target position calculation
tips.body: Automatically calculate the target position to generate a 'round' value for X, Y, Z.

tips.title: Correct electrode holder position for erosion geometry
tips.body: Select a value between 0 and 1 to correct the position of an electrode holder.

tips.title: Enable collision avoidance for electrode movements
tips.body: Check different parts of an electrode for collisions and increase linear extension or block size if necessary.

tips.title: Set distance for collision avoidance between electrode and workpiece
tips.body: Specify a safety distance to detect collisions.

tips.title: Control overhang of raw material
tips.body: Adjust the Z length based on the Database height, Electrode height with offset or minimum offset.

tips.title: Maintain minimum offset for raw material overhang
tips.body: Enter a value greater than 0 to ensure the minimum required offset is maintained.

tips.title: Select electrode material from drop-down menu
tips.body: Choose a material for the electrode from the XML file for materials.

tips.title: Specify number of electrodes for each spark gap
tips.body: Select the number of identical electrodes to be produced.

tips.title: Enter generator program for electrode type
tips.body: Select the required generator program from the XML file for generator programs.

tips.title: Document electrode creation date and modification date
tips.body: Use variables like %date% or %time% to automatically enter the current date and time.

tips.title: Select a value to reduce the reduction in relation to the block
tips.body: Enter a numerical value for reducing the reduction relative to the block.

tips.title: Select a marker type, e.g., radius or chamfer
tips.body: Choose between 'radius' and 'chamfer' for the measuring marker type.

tips.title: Enter the width of the chamfer at 45° or the radius of the arc
tips.body: For a chamfer, enter the width at 45°; for an arc, enter the radius.

tips.title: Default setting for the electrode name and milling project derived from it
tips.body: The default electrode name is based on the milling project.

tips.title: Default setting for the name of the workplane for positional reference
tips.body: The default workplane name is based on the electrode and workpiece relationship.

tips.title: Select the position of the measuring marker based on principal alignment
tips.body: Choose 'X' or 'Y' axis for the measuring marker orientation.

tips.title: Select the position of the electrode zero point
tips.body: Choose from electrode tip, top face, reduction bottom edge, electrode holder, or coupling at machine axis.

tips.title: Rotate electrodes by 180° for CAM programming
tips.body: Electrodes are rotated by 180° and an additional 90° about the Z-axis for transponder chip automation.

tips.title: Select the machine for collision check
tips.body: Choose a machine from the dynamically adapted drop-down menu.

tips.title: Select the reference system for the clearance plane
tips.body: Choose a reference system from the available options.

tips.title: Enter a distance in Z to be maintained above the workpiece
tips.body: Specify a Z value for maintaining clearance above the workpiece.

tips.title: Specify whether a dielectric is used
tips.body: Choose 'Yes' or 'No' to indicate the use of a dielectric.

tips.title: Enter the height for the dielectric fluid level
tips.body: Specify a numerical value for the dielectric fluid height.

tips.title: Select the rotation angle interval for the C axis
tips.body: Choose between '0° - 360°' or '-180° - 180°'.

tips.title: Select the EDM priority
tips.body: Choose from 'low wear', 'normal', 'high removal', or 'view structure'.

tips.title: Enter the maximum number of electrode slots in the electrode changer
tips.body: Specify a numerical value for the maximum magazine positions.

tips.title: Select a directory for the milling project
tips.body: Choose a directory for storing electrode project data.

tips.title: Select a file for raw material and holder data
tips.body: Choose an XML file prepared in the 'Blockdataeditor' program.

tips.title: Select a file for machine heads data
tips.body: Choose an electrode_machine.xml file with information on collision check machines.

tips.title: Select a file for electrode color import data
tips.body: Choose an *.hcmaterials.xml file with the electrode color palette.

tips.title: Select a file for orbit types data
tips.body: Choose an Electrode_orbit.xml file with information on electrode orbits.

tips.title: Select a file for materials data
tips.body: Choose a default.densities.xml file with information on materials.

tips.title: Select a file for generator program data
tips.body: Choose an electrode_generator_programs.xml file with performance parameters for eroding.

tips.title: Select colors for various electrode faces
tips.body: Choose colors for Contact face I, Erosion faces H, Extensions E F G, Reduction top face D, etc.

tips.title: Lock the workpiece to prevent unintentional shifting or scaling
tips.body: Use the Edit → Lock entities command to lock the workpiece.

tips.title: Add faces to expand the collision model
tips.body: Select faces with TAG information and apply them as a collision model.

tips.title: Avoid selecting faces that are trimmed on the measured side
tips.body: This can lead to inaccurate bounding box creation and potential collisions.

tips.title: Select an additional reference point for the eroding machine
tips.body: If the part's reference point cannot be reached by the machine, select a point of an entity.

tips.title: Align the bounding box to the axes of the current workplane
tips.body: Alternatively, specify a suitable plane face as an Entity.

tips.title: Create a coordinate label for the electrode in relation to the reference point
tips.body: The coordinates and text can be read from every ‘View’ and in the electrode summary.

tips.title: Only select the 'Automatic computation' option once all entries have been selected
tips.body: In particular, the faces for the erosion area.

tips.title: Select a workplane as a reference system from the list or in the graphics area
tips.body: If no reference systems are available, create a workplane using the Create reference system command.

tips.title: Select the faces for the electrode geometry either directly or using a closed chain of curves
tips.body: When switching from Contour to Faces, the last value used in the dialog for Geometry → Min. Tangent extension is restored.

tips.title: Select a planar closed chain of curves outside the model
tips.body: The curves will be projected onto the model in the Z direction.

tips.title: Use the Analysis → Shape spherical command to determine areas to be eroded
tips.body: This can help avoid collisions and ensure accurate electrode creation.

tips.title: Guide the Tangent extension up to the bounding box
tips.body: The affected faces of the erosion face area itself will be enlarged based on their parameters.

tips.title: Adjust tangent extension for erosion faces
tips.body: Select minimum length of a tangent extension at edges of erosion faces, avoiding curves that cross into remaining workpiece geometry.

tips.title: Set minimum linear extension for electrode geometry
tips.body: Select the minimum length of a linear extension at edges of erosion faces or tangential extension, using collision avoidance and distance for increased length.

tips.title: Automatically close holes from single faces
tips.body: Features such as holes and breakthroughs inside a Domain with a single continuous face boundary can be closed automatically.

tips.title: Create user-defined electrode geometry
tips.body: Extend existing electrode geometry to create a complete electrode by selecting manually prepared faces or externally prepared electrode geometries.

tips.title: Select electrode color palette for erosion faces
tips.body: Erosion faces must be assigned colors from the electrode color palette to ensure proper labeling and identification.

tips.title: Select workplane for electrode operations
tips.body: Select a workplane generated using the Create reference system command as the reference system for electrode operations.

tips.title: Define electrode name and description
tips.body: Change the second half of the electrode name and provide a description, with automatic counter insertion for repeated names.

tips.title: Select raw material shape for electrodes
tips.body: Choose cuboid or cylinder shapes for electrode raw materials, with automatic size selection or manual override.

tips.title: Select electrode shape for multiple electrodes
tips.body: Automatically adapt different electrode heights for creating a multiple electrode setup.

tips.title: Keep original faces when creating new electrode geometry
tips.body: Specify whether to retain the selected faces and create a copy, or replace them with the new face within solids.

tips.title: Attach electrode holder to electrode geometry
tips.body: Select the Insert electrode holder option to attach an electrode holder to the electrode geometry.

tips.title: Adjust electrode attributes for geometry, technology, etc.
tips.body: Modify attributes such as geometry, technology, document, position reference, and eroding machine from the Electrode options.

tips.title: Check and adjust target position for electrode
tips.body: Ensure the Target position is correctly set, as rotating a electrode may require specific handling.

tips.title: Create virtual electrodes from master electrode
tips.body: Select the master electrode and create one or several virtual electrodes, preventing identical electrodes from repeatedly appearing physically in the model.

tips.title: Manage virtual electrode status and reference system
tips.body: Change the status of a virtual electrode to Virtual II, Copied, Extract, or Delete, and select a reference system if multiple are defined.

tips.title: Reuse existing electrode in another project
tips.body: Ensure the EDM reference system, world workplanes, and machine head are identical in both projects for successful reuse of an electrode.

tips.title: Paste electrode from clipboard in another project
tips.body: Paste the group and reference position of an electrode from the clipboard, ensuring no collision check is carried out during paste.

tips.title: Check virtual electrodes after reuse
tips.body: Use the Virtual electrode command to check whether virtual electrodes of the original project still exist and delete if necessary.

tips.title: Specify a coordinate system for analysis
tips.body: Select from NCS, Frame and WP.

tips.title: Limit feedrate for analysis
tips.body: Min.: Manually change the smallest feedrate to be analyzed. Max.: Manually change the largest feedrate.

tips.title: Set number of colors for feedrate intervals
tips.body: Manually change the number of feedrate intervals between 3 and 100.

tips.title: Analyze distances between surfaces and toolpath
tips.body: Select entities, then perform analysis to determine distances.

tips.title: Set transparency for selected entities
tips.body: Select entities under Shape and set a transparency level.

tips.title: Limit toolpath analysis to an area inside or outside a selection area
tips.body: Select entities and choose 'Inside toolpath' for analysis within the selected area.

tips.title: Display remaining rest material for visual analysis
tips.body: Select entities and enable 'Rest material display' to visualize the remaining material.

tips.title: Optimize parameters of barrel cutters based on surface and curve information
tips.body: Select a barrel cutter, then select the surface and curves for optimization.

tips.title: Select an individual curve for tool preview
tips.body: Enter a value or use the slider to move the determined tool geometry along the curve.

tips.title: Adjust tool preview with Face offset
tips.body: Enter a value to enlarge the internal tool shape, reducing the preview area.

tips.title: Change tool position relative to surface normal
tips.body: Select 'Cutting side' to change the tool's position inside or outside the surface.

tips.title: Reverse infeed direction of the tool
tips.body: Select 'Infeed direction' to reverse the tool's infeed direction relative to the curve orientation.

tips.title: Use Global mode for optimal tool shape calculation
tips.body: Select 'Global mode' to calculate the optimal tool shape considering all selected curves.

tips.title: Edit toolpath interactively
tips.body: Right-click the graphics area to open the context menu and select 'Edit toolpath'.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by points
tips.body: Select 'Trim by points' and use 'Select → First' and 'Select → Second' to trim the toolpath.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by group
tips.body: Select 'Trim by group' and use 'Select → Select' to trim a group of G1/G2/G3 points between two G0 points.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by selection modes
tips.body: Select one of the available Modes to trim the toolpath from the current view direction.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by plane modes
tips.body: Select one of the available Modes to trim the toolpath exactly where the selection and toolpath intersect.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by curves modes
tips.body: Select one of the available Modes to trim the toolpath exactly where the selection and toolpath intersect.

tips.title: Invert selection for trimming toolpaths
tips.body: Use 'Invert selection' to reverse the current selection before trimming.

tips.title: Untrim all toolpaths
tips.body: Use 'Untrim all' to undo all trims.

tips.title: Run a complete automation solution as a script
tips.body: Use the AUTOMATION Center to run a complete automation solution as a script.

tips.title: Prepare geometries for CAM-oriented construction tasks
tips.body: Use the 'Adaptive construction' commands to prepare geometries for CAM-oriented construction tasks.

tips.title: Close openings within faces
tips.body: Use the 'Shapes → Close holes' command to close openings within faces.

tips.title: Create extension faces for milling
tips.body: Use the 'Shapes → Extension faces' command to create extension faces for milling.

tips.title: Join multiple free-form or analytical faces into a face
tips.body: Use the 'Shapes → Global fitting' command to join multiple free-form or analytical faces into a single face.

tips.title: Set density for tessellation
tips.body: Density: Set a density for the tessellation of the face group. The selection is limited to integers from 1 (large) to 10 (small).

tips.title: Set sampling points for tessellation
tips.body: Sampling points: Set a factor for the selection of the best tessellation points. The selection is limited to integers from 1 (large) to 10 (small).

tips.title: Set smoothing factor for tessellation
tips.body: Smoothing factor: Enter a factor for the smoothing around the best points in the inner area of the selected face group. The selection is limited to integers from 1 (small) to 10 (large).

tips.title: Set extension percentage for face deformation
tips.body: Extension (%): Enlarge the deformation space greater than the size of the target face.

tips.title: Set tangency tolerance for face formation
tips.body: Tangency tolerance check: Enter the maximum tangential deviation in the selected face formation, between the adjacent faces.

tips.title: Set sewing tolerance for face gaps
tips.body: Sewing tolerance: Enter the permissible size of face gaps within all selected faces for which face boundaries are still regarded as continuous.

tips.title: Set sampling method for tessellation
tips.body: Sampling method: Perform the calculation based on the existing tessellation (option: Tessellate) or based on a temporarily created grid with evenly sized triangles (option: Uniform sampling).

tips.title: Set extension width for faces
tips.body: Extension width: Enter the extension width.

tips.title: Set normal direction for face extensions
tips.body: Normal direction: An extension is automatically calculated from the direction of the adjacent boundary of the given faces.

tips.title: Set tolerance for face extension calculation
tips.body: Tolerance: The tolerance is required to find the free (open) edges and to orientate between selected and adjacent faces.

tips.title: Set stop face width for milling extensions
tips.body: Width: Enter the width of the stop surfaces.

tips.title: Check for undercuts in milling extensions
tips.body: Use the Check undercuts option to determine whether an undercut in the faces to be created results from a tool approach direction due to the orientation of the surfaces to be processed.

tips.title: Set direction for milling extensions
tips.body: Set the planned static tool position by selecting the Direction in Milling frame Z axis.

tips.title: Check adjacent faces for milling extensions
tips.body: Check the relationships of the adjacency at the tangential transitions to other faces.

tips.title: Set center line for wrapping side shell
tips.body: Center line: Select a line along the Y axis of the world workplane.

tips.title: Set section curve for wrapping side shell
tips.body: Section curve: Select an individual curve as the profile of the side shell.

tips.title: Set radial reference point for wrapping side shell
tips.body: Radial reference point: Specify a reference point for the position of the entities along the section curve.

tips.title: Set curves to be projected for wrapping side shell
tips.body: Curves to be projected: Select entities.

tips.title: Set center line for wrapping tread
tips.body: Center line: Select a line along the Y axis of the world workplane.

tips.title: Set section curve for wrapping tread
tips.body: Section curve: Select an individual curve as the profile of the segment cross-section.

tips.title: Set zero point for wrapping tread
tips.body: Zero point: Select a reference point on which the entities are projected and from which the unwrapping is calculated.

tips.title: Set curves to be projected for wrapping tread
tips.body: Curves to be projected: Select entities.

tips.title: Set output layer for wrapping tread
tips.body: Output layer: Enter a name for a resulting layer.

tips.title: Set tolerance for wrapping tread
tips.body: Tolerance: Specify a maximum permissible deviation for the approximation.
